name: MTAG
recent: MTAG 于 2026 年 10 月签署意向书，拟以 1380 万令吉现金收购两家标签制造商 L.H. Label (M) 和 L.H. Labelprint 的全部股权。此前，其全资子公司 MTAG Land 以 5358 万令吉收购柔佛新山空地的买卖协议已于 2026 年 8 月 28 日转为无条件。公司也发布了 2026 财年年报，并将在 2026 年 11 月 26 日召开第 9 届常年股东大会。

Printing firm MTAG proposes RM13.8 mil cash acquisition of two label makers
MTAG’s RM53.58m Johor Bahru land deal turns unconditional

recent_en: In October 2026, MTAG signed a letter of intent to acquire two label makers, L.H. Label (M) and L.H. Labelprint, for RM13.8 million cash. Earlier, the sale and purchase agreement for its wholly-owned subsidiary MTAG Land's RM53.58 million acquisition of vacant land in Johor Bahru became unconditional on 28 August 2026.
notable_en: Signed a letter of intent to acquire 100% equity interest in L.H. Label (M) and L.H. Labelprint for RM13.8 million cash.
The sale and purchase agreement for wholly-owned subsidiary MTAG Land's RM53.58 million acquisition of vacant land in Johor Bahru became unconditional on 28 August 2026.
Released its FY2026 annual report and scheduled its 9th AGM for 26 November 2026.
